text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Your glasses look wonderful on both of 
you. Hayahide-san looks refined, and 
Ikuno-san looks intellectual...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so jealous that it suits you so 
well... Any glasses other than these don't 
look good on me at all..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's not true. Isn't it just that 
imagining a design different from usual 
feels a bit unfamiliar?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They're practically a part of me, after 
all. Even when I try on a different pair 
of glasses, I just end up feeling terribly 
awkward.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know what you mean...! Once, I put 
on round glasses like a great author, and 
I looked like a completely different 
person... Though rather than an author, I 
looked more like a struggling student...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So you've experienced that too! I once 
tried on a pair of cat-eye frames myself. 
There was a strict-looking schoolmarm 
staring back in the mirror...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It seems everyone followed the same path. 
Speaking of which, the sunglasses. He had 
such a shady vibe about him...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S-So it wasn't just me...! That's such a 
relief to hear.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
So all three of you are looking for a new 
pair. ...Then how about we go to the 
optical shop and try on glasses to show 
each other?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's a great idea! Let's all share our 
thoughts. Getting an objective perspective 
might actually help us find glasses that 
suit us best.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! I'd love to go. I have a feeling 
a new encounter awaits us...!
